arxiv-2204-04181.title: Superspace First-order Formalism for Massless Arbitrary Superspin Supermultiplets
arxiv-2204-04181.creator: Konstantinos Koutrolikos
arxiv-2204-04181.description: Abstract A new description of free massless superfields of arbitrary superspin Y ( Y > 1 / 2 {\textsf{Y}}>1/2 ) is proposed. Following the first-order philosophy, we relax some of the properties (reality, gauge redundancy) of the unconstrained higher spin prepotentials and we construct first and half order invariants quantities. These are used to write trivially invariant actions.

Personal use of this material is permitted. Permission from IEEE must be obtained for all other uses, in any current or f
arxiv-2311-04649.creator: J. Xavier Salvat Lozano, Andres Garcia-Saavedra, Xi Li, Xavier Costa Perez
arxiv-2311-04649.description: Abstract Radio Access Networks virtualization (vRAN) is on its way becoming a reality driven by the new requirements in mobile networks, such as scalability and cost reduction. Unfortunately, there is no free lunch but a high price to be paid in terms of computing overhead introduced by noisy neighbors problem when multiple virtualized base station instances share computing platforms.

arxiv-2402-05591.title: SoftEDA: Rethinking Rule-Based Data Augmentation with Soft Labels
arxiv-2402-05591.creator: Juhwan Choi, Kyohoon Jin, Junho Lee, Sangmin Song, Youngbin Kim
arxiv-2402-05591.description: Abstract Rule-based text data augmentation is widely used for NLP tasks due to its simplicity. However, this method can potentially damage the original meaning of the text, ultimately hurting the performance of the model. To overcome this limitation, we propose a straightforward technique for applying soft labels to augmented data.

arxiv-2501-12823.title: To Measure or Not: A Cost-Sensitive, Selective Measuring Environment for Agricultural Management Decisions with Reinforcement Learning
arxiv-2501-12823.creator: Hilmy Baja, Michiel Kallenberg, Ioannis N. Athanasiadis
arxiv-2501-12823.description: Abstract Farmers rely on in-field observations to make well-informed crop management decisions to maximize profit and minimize adverse environmental impact. However, obtaining real-world crop state measurements is labor-intensive, time-consuming and expensive. In most cases, it is not feasible to gather crop state measurements before every decision moment.

arxiv-2512-17958.title: Real-Time Human-Robot Interaction Intent Detection Using RGB-based Pose and Emotion Cues with Cross-Camera Model Generalization
arxiv-2512-17958.creator: Farida Mohsen, Ali Safa
arxiv-2512-17958.description: Abstract Service robots in public spaces require real-time understanding of human behavioral intentions for natural interaction. We present a practical multimodal framework for frame-accurate human–robot interaction intent detection that fuses camera-invariant 2D skeletal pose and facial emotion features extracted from monocular RGB video.

arxiv-2601-19591.title: 𝚪 \mathbf{\Gamma} -convergence and homogenisation for free discontinuity functionals with linear growth in the space of functions with bounded deformation Thanks: Preprint SISSA 01/2026/MATE
arxiv-2601-19591.creator: Gianni Dal Maso, Davide Donati
arxiv-2601-19591.description: Abstract . We study the Γ \Gamma -convergence of sequences of free discontinuity functionals with linear growth defined in the space BD {\rm BD} of functions with bounded deformation. We prove a compactness result with respect to Γ \Gamma -convergence and outline the main properties of the Γ \Gamma -limits, which lead to an integral representation result.

pmc-11356795.creator: Carolina Roldão, Rita Lopes, Joana Matos Silva, Natália Neves, Joana Costa Gomes, Cristina Gavina, Tiago Taveira-Gomes

pmc-11359581.creator: Kathryn Shoemaker, Karina Soboleva, Angela Branche, Shivanjali Shankaran, Deborah A Theodore, Muhammad Bari, Victor Ezeh, Justin Green, Elizabeth Kelly, Dongmei Lan, Urban Olsson, Senthilkumar Saminathan, Nirmal Kumar Shankar, Berta Villegas, Tonya Villafana, Ann R Falsey, Magdalena E Sobieszczyk, A
pmc-11359581.description: A better understanding of the long-term safety, efficacy, and immunogenicity of COVID-19 vaccines is needed. This phase 3, randomized, placebo-controlled study for AZD1222 (ChAdOx1 nCoV-19) primary-series vaccination enrolled 32,450 participants in the USA, Chile, and Peru between August 2020 and January 2021 (NCT04516746). Endpoints included the 2-year follow-up assessment of safety, efficacy, and immunogenicity.

pmc-12708665.title: Transcriptional regulation of protein synthesis by mediator kinase represents a therapeutic vulnerability in MYC-driven medulloblastoma
pmc-12708665.creator: Dong Wang, Caitlin Ritz, Yuhuan Luo, Ammu Suresh, Angela Pierce, Bethany Veo, Breauna Brunt, Nathan Dahl, Natalie Serkova, Sujatha Venkataraman, Etienne Danis, Kamil Kus, Milena Mazan, Tomasz Rzymski, Rajeev Vibhakar
pmc-12708665.description: MYC-driven medulloblastoma (MB) is a highly aggressive brain tumor with poor prognosis and limited treatment options. Through CRISPR-Cas9 screening, we identify the Mediator-associated kinase CDK8 as a critical regulator of MYC-driven MB. Both genetic loss and pharmacological inhibition of CDK8 impair MB tumor growth.

pmc-12750372.title: Discovery of peptidomimetic inhibitors of CREB/CBP by targeting hydrophobic grooves on the surface of the CBP KIX domain
pmc-12750372.creator: Bo Huang, Emily Gregory-Lott, Bingbing X. Li, Timothy H. Tran, Sihao Li, Menglin Xue, Shaohui Wang, Anabanadam Asokan, Ning Shen, Xingming Sun, Chuanhai Cao, Xiangshu Xiao, Gary Daughdrill, Jianfeng Cai
pmc-12750372.description: Cyclic AMP-response element binding protein (CREB), a downstream transcription factor of multiple signaling pathways, is overexpressed in many different types of cancers. Thus, targeting CREB has great potential for the development of antitumor agents. Peptidic foldamers have emerged as a powerful tool to disrupt disease-related protein–protein interactions (PPIs) with chemodiversity and high stability towards enzymatic degradation.

pmc-13197536.title: Genetic dissection of apricot fruit skin color (Prunus armeniaca L.) using SNP and SSR molecular markers
pmc-13197536.creator: Germán Ortuño-Hernández, Lorenzo Bergonzoni, Stefano Tartarini, Mónica Moya-Andreo, Jesús López-Alcolea, David Ruiz, Pedro Martínez-Gómez, Luca Dondini, Juan Alfonso Salazar
pmc-13197536.description: Fruit skin color is a key quality trait in apricot, strongly influencing consumer preference and market value. However, phenotypic evaluation of this trait is time-consuming and highly dependent on environmental conditions and harvest timing. This study aimed to develop reliable molecular markers associated with apricot skin color to support marker-assisted selection in breeding programs.

pmc-13486836.title: NRP1 silencing induces ROS-mediated cell cycle arrest and mitochondrial apoptosis in non-small cell lung cancer via upregulation of AGER
pmc-13486836.creator: Ya Yang, Ying Li, Yongjuan Zhao, Wenwen Feng, Pengcheng Yu, Shan Li, Zongli Ding
pmc-13486836.description: Highlights•NRP1 is significantly upregulated, whereas AGER is downregulated in NSCLC tissues.•Silencing NRP1 inhibits NSCLC cell proliferation and induces G1 phase arrest.•NRP1 knockdown triggers mitochondria-dependentk apoptosis and ROS accumulation.•AGER overexpression suppresses cell growth and mimics the effects of NRP1 silencing.•The NRP1–AGER axis regulates oxidative stress–mediated tumor progression in NSCLC.
